svg.desc: Negative downsampling. The full log is 3 percent clicks; keeping all clicks and 10 percent of non-clicks gives a training set that is 24 percent clicks. A model trained on it predicts far too high; the re-calibration p = q / (q + (1 - q) / w) multiplies the odds by w and restores calibrated probabilities without changing the ranking.

svg.text: Keep every click and a fraction w of the non-clicks, then undo the bias exactly.
